stem: Listen!  The baby ____ in the bedroom.  Why don't you go in and take a look?
explain_zh: Listen! 提示現在正聽到寶寶在哭，強調「當下正在發生」的動作要用現在進行式，故選 is crying。cried、cries 分別是過去式、現在簡單式，will cry 是未來式，都不符合「此刻正在哭」的情境。

stem: Jill is ____ that the city park is closed for the music festival because now she can't jog there.
explain_zh: 公園因音樂節而關閉，Jill 因此不能去慢跑，這是令人「不開心」的事，故選 unhappy。excited（興奮的）、proud（驕傲的）、scared（害怕的）都與「不能運動而不悅」的心情不符。

stem: Steven wants to be a ____, because he loves to watch people enjoy the food he prepares.
explain_zh: 他喜歡看別人享用自己準備的食物，可知他想當的是「廚師」，故選 cook。doctor、driver、farmer 的工作內容都與「準備食物給人享用」無關。

stem: Paul misses his parents a lot.  He ____ them since he came to work in Taiwan a year ago.
explain_zh: since he came to Taiwan a year ago 表示「從一年前到現在」，要用現在完成式表達「一直沒有見到」，故選 hasn't seen。didn't see、doesn't see 是過去式與現在式，won't see 是未來式，皆無法搭配 since 表示持續到現在的狀態。

stem: Our teacher Ms. Wu seldom laughs, but when she ____, everyone in the same building can hear her.
explain_zh: when 引導的時間副詞子句要用現在簡單式代替未來式，且此處代替前面的 laughs，故選 does。can、has、will 都不能單獨代替一般動詞 laughs 的意思，也不符合子句用現在式的規則。

stem: My sister is coming to my home today.  She ____ with me for a week.
explain_zh: 姊姊今天要來，並「將會」在這裡待一週，描述未來的計畫要用未來式，故選 will stay。stays 是現在式、stayed 是過去式、has stayed 是現在完成式，時態都不符合「即將發生」的语意。

stem: Edward had worked as a computer engineer for ten years.  This ____ helped him a lot when he started his own computer shop.
explain_zh: 當過十年的電腦工程師，這段「經歷」對他後來開店很有幫助，故選 experience。chance（機會）、hobby（嗜好）、knowledge（知識，較偏理論）都不如 experience 貼切表達「十年工作累積的實務經驗」。

stem: If you're interested in our business plan, ____ this number and ask for Ms. Lee.  She'll answer your questions.
explain_zh: 句首給建議、指示，用祈使句原形動詞開頭，故選 call。calling 是動名詞、and call 多了不必要的連接詞、to call 是不定詞，都不能直接作為祈使句的主要動詞放在句首。

stem: Jimmy would not get up for breakfast, ____ his dad had already tried to pull him from his bed several times.
explain_zh: 爸爸已經試著拉他起床好幾次了，他卻還是不肯起床，前後語意是「儘管…卻…」的讓步關係，故選 although。because 表原因、if 表條件、until 表直到，都無法呈現「已經這麼努力了，他還是不起床」的對比語氣。

stem: Duncan spent all his money trying to ____ the bookstore his mom left him.  Sadly, the business never got better, and he had to close it in the end.
explain_zh: 生意始終沒有起色、最後只能收掉，可知 Duncan 花光了錢是想「挽救」媽媽留給他的書店，故選 save（挽救）。build（建造）、buy（購買）、start（開始經營）都與「已經擁有卻想辦法讓它撐下去」的情境不符。

stem: Fiona loves listening to her children sing songs ____ at school.
explain_zh: songs 後面接的是省略關係代名詞的子句，原句是 songs (that/which) they learned at school，受詞關代可省略，故選 they learned。are learned 少了關代且時態不合；that learned 缺主詞、that they are learned 文法重複贅字，都不通順。

stem: Beverly eats lots of snacks ____ meals.  That's why she is often too full to eat anything at mealtimes.
explain_zh: 在正餐「之間」吃零食才會導致正餐吃不下，故選 between meals（餐與餐之間）。after（之後）、during（在…期間，通常指單一事件）、from（從）都無法表達「兩餐之間」的時間概念。

stem: Nora: Can I check your drawer for some tools we can use? Matt: Sure.  Take a look.  See if you can find ____ in there.
explain_zh: 在疑問句／可能句中詢問「有沒有任何工具」，用 any 代替前面提到的 tools，故選 any。it 是單數代名詞、others 指「其他的」、those 需要有特定範圍才能使用，皆不符合此處泛指「任何」的語意。

Letting people know what is on sale at e-BeautiMed from 7/1 to 8/31.

stem: What can we learn about Lynn from the dialogue?
options: She likes to try new food.
She did not enjoy the food at Caldron.
She changed Joey's idea about Caldron.
explain_zh: Lynn 抱怨在 Caldron 得自己下鍋煮，東西都是同一鍋煮出來，吃起來都一個味道，還一直丟奇怪的東西進鍋裡，顯示她很不喜歡那次用餐經驗，故選 C。文中並未說她不煮飯（A）或喜歡嘗試新食物（B，其實她抱怨連連）。
passage:
Joey: Lynn, have you tried Caldron?  I've heard that restaurant is good.
Lynn: I have.  I went there once for Tom's party.
Joey: And?
Lynn: Well, I never thought I would have to cook for myself when eating out.
Joey: But it's fun to cook your own food.
Lynn: I don't see any fun in that.  Besides, I want nice food.
Joey: So you didn't like the food there?
Lynn: Everything tasted the same.  I mean, they were all cooked in the same boiling pot.  How could they taste different?  I just kept throwing strange things into the pot.  I didn't even know what half the things were made of.
Joey: Don't worry.  Everything should be safe to eat after a hot bath in the pot.  And you didn't get sick after that, right?  Besides, you tried something different there.  Still a good experience, I think?
Lynn: I don't think we share the same idea of good experiences.

stem: What do we know about Woollie from Katie's diary?
options: Woollie was taken to visit sick kids.
Woollie was sick when he ran away.
Woollie looked strange without his fleece.
explain_zh: 故事書說 Woollie 四歲時走失，六年後才被 Armstrong 先生找到，找到時 Katie 剛好出生，可推算 Woollie 走失時的年紀比 Katie 大，故選 A。文中沒說牠曾被帶去探望生病的孩子（B，是牠的毛被拿去義賣籌款）或走失時生病（C）。
passage:
Dear Diary, June 7, 2011
I was very sad to hear what happened to Woollie yesterday.  Woollie was my favorite sheep.  I have a storybook about Woollie.  It says when Woollie was four, he ran away from Mr. Armstrong's farm, and it took Mr. Armstrong six years to find Woollie.  But Woollie had grown so much fleece that he didn't even look like a sheep.  Mr. Armstrong decided to cut his fleece on TV so everyone could see.  Daddy said this happened on the day I was born.  Woollie's fleece weighed 27 kg, and could make clothes for 20 large men.  I asked Daddy if his favorite vest was made from Woollie's fleece.  Daddy said no, because Woollie's fleece was sold to collect money for sick kids.  In the storybook, Woollie was taken to see Ms. Stella Clark, the leader of our city then.  They even had tea together.  Daddy said Woollie did meet Ms. Clark, but he wasn't sure if they had tea.  Daddy said Woollie was put down because he was too sick and there was no way to help him.  I cried.  I hope Woollie will be happy up there in the sky.

stem: What happened when Woollie was put down?
explain_zh: 日記最後說爸爸提到 Woollie 因為病得太重、沒辦法醫治，所以被安樂死（was put down），也就是牠去世了，故選 C。牠並沒有被賣掉（A）、找不到（B）或因此成名（D，牠原本就因剪毛活動出名）。

stem: What can we learn about The Piano Lesson from the reading?
options: Matisse painted it when his son was away from home.
The woman who sits on a seat behind the boy is his mother.
Matisse uses yellow and red to show that his son was happy.
The candle on the piano shows that the piano lesson has just begun.
explain_zh: 文末提到 Pierre 當時已經當兵離家，馬蒂斯不確定他能不能平安回來，這幅畫很可能是憂心的父親懷念從前美好時光的方式，可知創作時兒子人不在家，故選 A。畫中右上角的女子其實是另一幅畫（B錯），灰色代表憂鬱而非快樂（C錯），蠟燭燒到快沒了才暗示練習已久（D錯，不是剛開始）。
passage:
Here's The Piano Lesson, one of Henri Matisse's most famous paintings.  The boy in the picture is the painter's son, Pierre.  In the picture, Pierre looks quite serious.  Why?  Well, look at the yellow candle on the red piano.  It's almost burned down.  So maybe Pierre has already practiced for hours.  And Matisse uses a lot of gray, not a very fun color, right?  It shows how the poor kid feels, don't you think?
On the top right corner, you can see a woman sitting straight on a seat.  Is she Pierre's piano teacher?  Or his mother?  Well, if you're a Matisse fan, you'll know this is in fact another painting by him, Woman on a High Stool.  Interesting, right?  Matisse likes to do that a lot.  In fact, there's another work by Matisse in the picture.  Did you find it?  Right!  The sculpture on the bottom left corner!
Matisse painted this picture in 1916.  Pierre was already 16 then, but the artist painted his son much younger than he really was.  Pierre had gone away to be a soldier, and Matisse didn't know whether he would come back.  Maybe this is a worried father's way to remember the good old days.

stem: What does "do that" mean in the reading?
options: Put his family in his paintings.
Paint to remember the good old days.
Use a lot of fun colors in his art works.
Put his earlier art work in a new painting.
explain_zh: 文中提到畫裡的女子與左下角的雕塑其實都是馬蒂斯自己「其他作品」的畫中畫，這種把自己舊作放進新畫裡的做法就是 do that，故選 D。並非單純把家人畫進畫裡（A）或使用繽紛色彩（C，此畫其實用色偏灰）。

stem: What idea is talked about in the reading?
options: How Teachers' Day is celebrated now.
Why Teachers' Day was celebrated at first.
Why Confucius was seen as a great teacher.
How teachers today feel about Teachers' Day.
explain_zh: 文章開頭先點出一般人對教師節由來的既定印象，接著花大篇幅說明教師節最初其實是為了讓老師發聲、爭取權益而設立，重點在解釋「教師節最初為何被慶祝」，故選 B。文章沒有詳細介紹現在教師節怎麼過（A）或現代教師的感受（D）。
passage:
On Teachers' Day, we thank our teachers for their hard work.  We also celebrate this day to remember Confucius, the great Chinese teacher from 2,500 years ago.  Well, that's everything we're taught about Teachers' Day.  But, the first Teachers' Day was not on Confucius's birthday, and it was not about thanking our teachers.
In 1930, Mr. Tai Shuang-qiu and other teachers celebrated the first Teachers' Day in Nanjing.  But there was nothing to celebrate.  Teachers were paid very little and not respected.  These teachers took this chance to shout out their problems.  They had Teachers' Day on June 6 because the date was easy to remember and near the end of the school year.  This action by Mr. Tai and the other teachers was welcomed and followed by teachers from other cities.  In 1939, the government made Teachers' Day a national holiday.  However, it was on August 27, the day when Confucius's birthday was celebrated.  Not everyone hailed this decision: Teachers' Day was never about Confucius, and Confucius couldn't speak for all the teachers either.
One funny thing was that the government was wrong about the date of Confucius's birthday.  In 1952, people found out he was in fact born on September 28.  That was when we started to celebrate Teachers' Day on Confucius's real birthday.

stem: Which is true about Teachers' Day from the reading?
options: It used to be celebrated on different dates.
It was started by students for their teachers.
It has been celebrated in Nanjing for over 2,500 years.
Teachers decided to celebrate it on Confucius's birthday.
explain_zh: 文中提到教師節最初訂在 6 月 6 日，後來政府又改到孔子誕辰（誤植的 8 月 27 日），1952 年才又改回正確的 9 月 28 日，可知日期曾經多次變動，故選 A。它並非由學生發起（B，是老師自己發起），南京慶祝的歷史沒有長達 2500 年（C，2500年是指孔子時代），也不是老師自己決定用孔子生日（D，是政府決定的）。

stem: Why does National Formosa Railway write this letter?
options: There is a train ticket sale.
A train line will be closed in July.
It will open a new train line in August.
Some of its trains will run on different lines.
explain_zh: 信中說明因颱風影響，8月14日至28日部分路線將改道行駛、部分車站將不停靠，這封信的目的是通知旅客「部分列車將改走其他路線」，故選 D。並非在宣傳車票特賣（A）或宣布新路線開通（C），該路段是暫時關閉而非永久（B錯，僅指出關閉時間）。
passage:
Dear Traveler,
You have bought an NFR ticket online for a train that runs between White Water City and Cloud City.
We are sorry to tell you that, because of the typhoon last month, the Sand Town – Spring Town line will be closed between August 14 and 28 2016.  During this time, some trains will change lines and will not stop at a few stations.  There will be free buses to take travelers to these stations.  Please check below for the changes.  Visit http://www.nfr.gov/ for more information.
We wish you a nice summer.
Lena Muller, National Formosa Railway

Trains that run between Green City and Cloud City will take the Smoke Town – Spring Town line, and will stop at every station.  The free buses for the Sand Town – Spring Town line will wait at Green City (going south) and Spring Town (going north) stations.  No stop at Gray Village.

options: No trains will stop at Spring Town.

stem: Below are the ideas that are talked about in the reading. a. The problems Darayya has. b. How Darayya's library was started. c. What makes Darayya's library special. d. How Darayya's library helps people there. In what order does the writer put his ideas in the reading?
explain_zh: 文章先介紹這座地下圖書館「與眾不同之處」（c，秘密、地下），接著說明戰亂讓 Darayya 陷入困境（a），再描述學生們如何蓋出這座圖書館（b），最後說明圖書館如何幫助居民（d），順序為 c, a, b, d，故選 D。
passage:
In Darayya, a city in Syria, there's a library, and it has 15,000 books on almost every subject you can think of.  However, it is different from any libraries you know: It is a secret underground library, and only people in Darayya know where it is.
Over the years, war has shaken Darayya badly.  Every day, houses are bombed and people are killed.  Stores are closed one after another, and so are schools.  To help the kids in Darayya with their learning, Anas Ahmad, a 19-year-old student, and his friends decided to build a library.  They built the library under the ground to keep it safe from bombing.  But it is dangerous to collect books for the library.  Often, Ahmad and his friends look for books in houses that were bombed.  They need to be careful because they may be killed in another bombing.
You may ask, "In a place like Darayya, would people be interested in books?"  "Just like the body needs food, the mind needs books," says one library user.  In the library, people enjoy their time of reading and forget about the terrible world above, so their life doesn't seem so hard.  Through reading, they are able to dream of a better life after war.

stem: Why do people in Darayya go to the library even during the war?
options: They find joy and hope in reading.
They want to learn how to win the war.
Their school teachers give lessons there.
explain_zh: 文末引用讀者的話「心靈也需要書本的滋養」，並說人們在圖書館裡享受閱讀、忘卻戰爭的殘酷，藉此對未來抱有希望，故選 B。圖書館並非提供免費食物（A）或教人打仗（C），也沒有提到學校老師在此授課（D）。

stem: We know we told you that the party would be in ____. However, we just moved to Carlton City last month, so the party won't be in Pattersons Town. It'll be at Mosman Garden right next to Victor Zoo. Please don't go to Northbank Park next to our old house.
explain_zh: 後文說「派對不會辦在 Pattersons Town 了」「請不要去舊家附近的 Northbank Park」，可知原本說要辦的地點、現在要改期通知大家別去的地方就是 Northbank Park，故選 D。Victor Zoo、Mosman Garden 是新地點，Carlton City 是他們剛搬去的城市。
passage:
Hello Dave,
We're happy to invite you and your family to Daniel's fifth birthday party this Saturday.
We know we told you that the party would be in ____.  However, we just moved to Carlton City last month, so the party won't be in Pattersons Town.  It'll be at Mosman Garden right next to Victor Zoo, just across from our new apartment.  Please don't go to Northbank Park next to our old house.
The weather report said that it may be rainy this weekend, but ____.  If it rains, we'll move the party inside our home.  However, if we're ____ and it is fine, we'll still have the party at the garden.
Again, we're all very happy and excited to welcome you to join us for some fun this weekend!
Best,
Mia, Sam & Daniel

stem: The weather report said that it may be rainy this weekend, but ____. If it rains, we'll move the party inside our home.
options: we have a plan if this happens
we could just wait for the rain to stop
we should be fine if the rain isn't too heavy
we will let you know if we'll still have the party
explain_zh: 後句接著說「如果下雨，我們就把派對移到室內」，可知信中要表達的是「我們已經有應對下雨的計畫」，故選 A（we have a plan if this happens）。其餘選項語氣上都不如這句明確承接後文提到的備案。

stem: Soon after I walked into the park, I saw a man under a tree up ahead.  My heart fell.  The stories I'd heard about the park ____ into my head at this moment.
explain_zh: 此處描述「當下」看到樹下的人，過去聽過關於這座公園的種種傳聞「當時正陸續湧上心頭」，用過去進行式表達過去某一刻正在發生的心理狀態，故選 were all coming。are、have 時態不符過去語境，would 則缺乏過去進行的動態感。
passage:
Usually I wouldn't cross the park at this time of night.  But walking around the park would take more time, and it was raining so hard that I couldn't even see clearly what was right before me.  So I entered the park.  And that was the first stupid thing I did tonight.
Soon after I walked into the park, I saw a man under a tree up ahead.  My heart fell.  The stories I'd heard about the park ____ into my head at this moment.  Anyone with a clear mind would just turn back.  But me?  No.  I did ____ stupid thing: I decided to hurry past him.
Just when I was passing the man, he raised his head and gave me the strangest smile ever.  I got scared and started running.  "Hey!" the man shouted from behind.  "Wait!"  He was running after me!
I ran like crazy.  I had hoped the trees would keep some rain off.  And they ____.  But they also made the park look even darker.  I couldn't see what was ahead of me.  Then, I ran into something.  It was the man!
"Don't kill me!" I cried.
"What?  I ____ to give back your bag!  You dropped it," the man gave me my bag.
Now, I felt saying that to the man was the stupidest thing I did tonight.

stem: Anyone with a clear mind would just turn back. But me? No. I did ____ stupid thing: I decided to hurry past him.
explain_zh: 前面已提到「進入公園」是今晚做的第一件蠢事，這裡「決定加快腳步經過陌生人」則是「另一件」蠢事，故選 another（另一個，不特定）。one 缺乏「再一件」的對比語感，the last、the other 需要特定範圍才能使用，皆不合適。
